levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: the Imam written after «عن» inside the chain stays narrator (owner ruling 2); the bare kunya is written as it stands and not identified (ruling 3)
the two «أبي عبد الله» are two occurrences of the same words; the second is the last link, and the verse and exegesis after it are his words
